philippines.intro: The Philippines is a country of more than 7,000 islands, and most Indian families combine a day or two in Manila with beach time in Boracay or Palawan and the countryside of Bohol. English is widely spoken, people are friendly and helpful, and island hops are done by short domestic flights and boats.

destinations.name: Intramuros
destinations.blurb: Manila's old walled Spanish city, with Fort Santiago, cobbled streets and horse-drawn kalesa rides.

destinations.name: Boracay
destinations.blurb: A small island known for the long, soft White Beach, calm water and sunset sailing trips.

destinations.name: El Nido
destinations.blurb: A town in northern Palawan where island-hopping boats visit limestone lagoons and quiet beaches.

destinations.name: Puerto Princesa Subterranean River
destinations.blurb: A navigable underground river in Palawan, explored by paddle boat through a long limestone cave.

destinations.name: Chocolate Hills
destinations.blurb: More than a thousand grassy domes in Bohol that turn brown in the dry season, seen from a hilltop viewing deck.

destinations.name: Kawasan Falls
destinations.blurb: Turquoise tiered waterfalls in southern Cebu, often visited with a canyoneering trip.

destinations.name: Tagaytay
destinations.blurb: A cool ridge town south of Manila with views over Taal Lake and its volcano island.

devotional.name: San Agustin Church
devotional.blurb: A UNESCO-listed stone church in Intramuros, completed in 1607 and the oldest standing church in the country.

devotional.name: Manila Cathedral
devotional.blurb: The city's main Catholic cathedral, rebuilt several times, facing Plaza de Roma in Intramuros.

devotional.name: Basilica del Santo Nino
devotional.blurb: A basilica in Cebu City that keeps the Santo Nino image brought by Magellan's expedition in 1521.

devotional.name: Quiapo Church
devotional.blurb: Home of the Black Nazarene statue, drawing large crowds of devotees, especially on Fridays.

dishes.name: Chicken Adobo
dishes.blurb: Chicken braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and bay leaf, often called the national dish.

dishes.name: Sinigang
dishes.blurb: A sour tamarind soup with vegetables and pork, prawns or fish.

dishes.name: Lechon
dishes.blurb: Whole spit-roasted pig with crisp skin, served at fiestas and family feasts, especially in Cebu.

dishes.name: Turon
dishes.blurb: Sliced saba banana and jackfruit wrapped in a spring roll sheet, fried and coated in caramelised sugar.

dishes.name: Taho
dishes.blurb: Warm silken tofu with brown sugar syrup and sago pearls, sold by street vendors in the morning.

highlights: Island-hopping boat tour in El Nido
Sunset sail on a paraw boat off Boracay
Paddle boat ride through the underground river
Viewing deck at the Chocolate Hills
Kalesa ride through Intramuros
Snorkelling over coral reefs in Cebu or Palawan
philippines.indianTraveller: Indian restaurants are found in Manila's Makati area, Cebu and Boracay, though vegetarian choices are thinner on smaller islands; there are no direct flights from Hyderabad, so expect about 8 to 10 hours with a stop in Singapore, Kuala Lumpur or Bangkok, and pack a US-style plug adapter and some US dollars to change locally.

taiwan.intro: Taiwan is a safe, easy-going island with a fast metro and high-speed rail, which makes a week-long loop from Taipei to Taroko Gorge and Sun Moon Lake very manageable. Its long Buddhist tradition means vegetarian restaurants are common, and the night markets are a highlight for families of all ages.

destinations.name: Taipei 101
destinations.blurb: Once the world's tallest building, with an observatory on the 89th floor and a huge tuned mass damper on show.

destinations.name: National Palace Museum
destinations.blurb: A museum in Taipei holding one of the largest collections of Chinese imperial art, jade and porcelain.

destinations.name: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
destinations.blurb: A white memorial hall with a blue roof on a large plaza, known for its hourly changing of the guard.

destinations.name: Jiufen
destinations.blurb: A former gold-mining town on a hillside, with narrow lanes, lantern-lit teahouses and sea views.

destinations.name: Taroko Gorge
destinations.blurb: A marble canyon on the east coast with walking trails, cliff-side roads and the Eternal Spring Shrine.

destinations.name: Sun Moon Lake
destinations.blurb: Taiwan's largest lake, ringed by forested hills, with boat rides, cycle paths and a cable car.

destinations.name: Shilin Night Market
destinations.blurb: Taipei's best-known night market for street snacks, games and inexpensive shopping.

devotional.name: Longshan Temple
devotional.blurb: A busy temple in Taipei's Wanhua district, founded in 1738, where Buddhist and folk deities are worshipped together.

devotional.name: Fo Guang Shan Monastery
devotional.blurb: A large Buddhist monastery near Kaohsiung with a seated bronze Buddha and a museum.

devotional.name: Wen Wu Temple
devotional.blurb: A hillside temple on the shore of Sun Moon Lake with red stone lions and lake views.

devotional.name: Dalongdong Baoan Temple
devotional.blurb: A Taipei folk temple restored with UNESCO recognition for its carvings and painted halls.

dishes.name: Beef Noodle Soup
dishes.blurb: Wheat noodles in a rich, slow-cooked broth with tender braised beef.

dishes.name: Xiaolongbao
dishes.blurb: Thin-skinned steamed dumplings filled with pork and hot soup.

dishes.name: Gua Bao
dishes.blurb: A soft steamed bun folded around braised pork belly, peanut powder and pickled greens.

dishes.name: Stinky Tofu
dishes.blurb: Fermented tofu deep-fried until crisp and served with pickled cabbage and chilli sauce.

dishes.name: Douhua
dishes.blurb: Soft tofu pudding in sweet syrup, topped with peanuts, red beans or taro balls.

highlights: Sunset from the Taipei 101 observatory
Evening at Shilin Night Market
Teahouse stop in the lanes of Jiufen
Walk along the Shakadang Trail in Taroko Gorge
Boat ride across Sun Moon Lake
Releasing a sky lantern at Shifen Old Street
taiwan.indianTraveller: Buddhist vegetarian restaurants are easy to find, though many leave out onion and garlic, and Taipei has several Indian restaurants; there are no direct flights from Hyderabad, so plan on about 8 to 10 hours via Singapore, Bangkok or Hong Kong, and note that Taiwan uses US-style plugs at 110 volts.

bahrain.intro: Bahrain is a small island kingdom that suits a short break or a stopover, with old souqs, a seaside fort and modern malls within a short drive of each other. A large Indian community has lived here for generations, so familiar food, temples and Indian schools are part of everyday life in Manama.

destinations.name: Bahrain National Museum
destinations.blurb: A museum on the Manama waterfront covering Dilmun burial mounds, pearling and traditional life.

destinations.name: Bab Al Bahrain and Manama Souq
destinations.blurb: The old gateway to the city and the lanes behind it, full of spice, gold, textile and perfume shops.

destinations.name: Qal'at al-Bahrain
destinations.blurb: A UNESCO-listed fort and archaeological site on the north coast, best visited near sunset.

destinations.name: Tree of Life
destinations.blurb: A lone mesquite tree, around 400 years old, growing in the desert with no obvious water source.

destinations.name: Bahrain International Circuit
destinations.blurb: The Formula One track in Sakhir, which offers circuit tours and driving experiences outside race weekends.

destinations.name: Pearling Path in Muharraq
destinations.blurb: A UNESCO-listed trail through old Muharraq linking merchant houses, oyster beds and the seafront.

destinations.name: Bahrain World Trade Center
destinations.blurb: Twin towers on the Manama skyline joined by bridges carrying three large wind turbines.

devotional.name: Shrinathji Temple
devotional.blurb: A Krishna temple in the old Manama souq, about 200 years old and among the oldest Hindu temples in the Gulf.

devotional.name: Al Fateh Grand Mosque
devotional.blurb: One of the largest mosques in the region, open to visitors outside prayer times with free guided tours.

devotional.name: Sacred Heart Church
devotional.blurb: A Catholic church in Manama opened in 1939, the first church built in the Gulf in modern times.

devotional.name: Our Lady of Arabia Cathedral
devotional.blurb: A large Catholic cathedral in Awali, consecrated in 2021 with a design inspired by a desert tent.

dishes.name: Machboos
dishes.blurb: Spiced rice cooked with chicken, lamb or fish, dried lime and a Gulf spice mix.

dishes.name: Harees
dishes.blurb: Wheat slow-cooked with meat and beaten to a smooth porridge, popular during Ramadan.

dishes.name: Balaleet
dishes.blurb: Sweet vermicelli with saffron and cardamom, topped with a thin omelette, eaten at breakfast.

dishes.name: Muhammar
dishes.blurb: Sweet rice cooked with date syrup or sugar and flavoured with cardamom and rose water.

dishes.name: Bahraini Halwa
dishes.blurb: A soft, glossy sweet made with starch, sugar, ghee, saffron and nuts, sold in Muharraq's old shops.

highlights: Darshan at the Shrinathji Temple in the old souq
Guided tour of Al Fateh Grand Mosque
Sunset at Qal'at al-Bahrain
Walking the Pearling Path in Muharraq
Tour of the Bahrain International Circuit
Shopping in the gold souq near Bab Al Bahrain
bahrain.indianTraveller: Indian and pure-vegetarian restaurants are everywhere in Manama thanks to the large Indian community, flights from Hyderabad take about 4 hours, and Bahrain uses UK-style three-pin plugs, so carry an adapter and change rupees or dollars into dinars on arrival.

kuwait.intro: Kuwait is a compact Gulf country where many Indian families visit relatives, and a two or three day stay covers the main sights of Kuwait City. Expect a relaxed pace, a long corniche, well-kept museums and some of the best malls in the region.

destinations.name: Kuwait Towers
destinations.blurb: Three towers on the corniche, the tallest with a revolving viewing sphere over the Gulf.

destinations.name: Souq Al-Mubarakiya
destinations.blurb: One of the oldest markets in Kuwait, with dates, spices, perfumes and small restaurants.

destinations.name: Al Shaheed Park
destinations.blurb: A large landscaped park in the city centre with gardens, a lake and two small museums.

destinations.name: Sheikh Jaber Al-Ahmad Cultural Centre
destinations.blurb: A modern opera house and arts complex hosting concerts, theatre and exhibitions.

destinations.name: Tareq Rajab Museum
destinations.blurb: A private museum with Islamic calligraphy, jewellery, ceramics and costumes from across the Muslim world.

destinations.name: Failaka Island
destinations.blurb: An island reached by ferry, with Greek-era ruins, old village houses and quiet beaches.

destinations.name: The Avenues
destinations.blurb: One of the largest malls in the Middle East, with themed shopping districts and plenty of food courts.

devotional.name: Grand Mosque of Kuwait
devotional.blurb: The country's largest mosque, with a decorated main hall and guided tours for visitors outside prayer times.

devotional.name: Holy Family Cathedral
devotional.blurb: The Catholic cathedral in central Kuwait City, serving a large community of Indian and other expatriate worshippers.

devotional.name: National Evangelical Church
devotional.blurb: A Protestant church compound in Kuwait City founded in 1931, hosting services in many languages including Malayalam.

dishes.name: Machboos Dyay
dishes.blurb: Kuwait's national dish of spiced rice cooked with chicken, dried lime and baharat.

dishes.name: Mutabbaq Samak
dishes.blurb: Fried fish, often pomfret, served over rice cooked in the fish stock.

dishes.name: Harees
dishes.blurb: Wheat and meat slow-cooked into a smooth porridge, finished with ghee and cinnamon.

dishes.name: Lugaimat
dishes.blurb: Crisp fried dough balls soaked in date syrup and sprinkled with sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Muhammar
dishes.blurb: Sweet rice cooked with sugar or date syrup, saffron and cardamom.

highlights: View from the revolving sphere of Kuwait Towers
Evening walk along the Arabian Gulf corniche
Dinner in the lanes of Souq Al-Mubarakiya
Ferry day trip to Failaka Island
Guided tour of the Grand Mosque
Shopping at The Avenues
kuwait.indianTraveller: Indian vegetarian restaurants are easy to find across Kuwait City, flights from Hyderabad take roughly 4 to 5 hours depending on routing, alcohol is prohibited in the country, and Kuwait uses UK-style three-pin plugs, so pack an adapter and change money into dinars locally.

ireland.intro: Ireland is a green, friendly country of old towns, castles and dramatic Atlantic coastline, and English is spoken everywhere. A week usually covers Dublin, the west coast around Galway and the Cliffs of Moher, and the lakes and mountains of Kerry, ideally with a self-drive or a small-group tour.

destinations.name: Trinity College Dublin
destinations.blurb: The country's oldest university, home of the Book of Kells and the vaulted Long Room library.

destinations.name: Dublin Castle
destinations.blurb: A former seat of British rule in the city centre, with state apartments, gardens and a medieval tower.

destinations.name: Cliffs of Moher
destinations.blurb: Sea cliffs in County Clare rising more than 200 metres above the Atlantic, with a clifftop walking path.

destinations.name: Galway
destinations.blurb: A lively west coast city with a colourful Latin Quarter, street musicians and a long seafront promenade.

destinations.name: Ring of Kerry
destinations.blurb: A scenic driving loop around the Iveragh Peninsula past lakes, mountains and small coastal villages.

destinations.name: Killarney National Park
destinations.blurb: Lakes, woodland and waterfalls around Muckross House, with jaunting car rides through the park.

destinations.name: Blarney Castle
destinations.blurb: A medieval castle near Cork where visitors climb to the top to kiss the Blarney Stone.

devotional.name: St Patrick's Cathedral
devotional.blurb: Dublin's largest church, founded in 1191 and linked with Jonathan Swift, who was its dean.

devotional.name: Christ Church Cathedral
devotional.blurb: Dublin's oldest cathedral, with a large medieval crypt beneath its nave.

devotional.name: Rock of Cashel
devotional.blurb: A hilltop group of medieval church buildings and a round tower in County Tipperary.

devotional.name: Galway Cathedral
devotional.blurb: A large domed Catholic cathedral beside the River Corrib, completed in 1965.

devotional.name: St Fin Barre's Cathedral
devotional.blurb: A Gothic Revival cathedral in Cork with three spires and detailed stone carvings.

dishes.name: Irish Stew
dishes.blurb: Lamb or mutton slow-cooked with potatoes, onions and carrots.

dishes.name: Full Irish Breakfast
dishes.blurb: Sausages, bacon, eggs, black and white pudding, beans and toast.

dishes.name: Seafood Chowder
dishes.blurb: A creamy soup of fish and shellfish, served with brown bread in coastal towns.

dishes.name: Colcannon
dishes.blurb: Buttery mashed potato mixed with cabbage or kale and spring onions.

dishes.name: Irish Soda Bread
dishes.blurb: A dense bread made with buttermilk and baking soda, served warm with butter.

highlights: Seeing the Book of Kells at Trinity College
Clifftop walk at the Cliffs of Moher
Driving the Ring of Kerry
Jaunting car ride in Killarney National Park
Evening of live music in Galway
Kissing the Blarney Stone
ireland.indianTraveller: Indian restaurants are common in Dublin, Cork and Galway and most cafes offer vegetarian dishes, flights from Hyderabad take about 12 to 14 hours with one stop in the Gulf, and Ireland uses UK-style three-pin plugs, so carry an adapter and a forex card loaded with euros.

denmark.intro: Denmark is a small, orderly country that is easy to travel with children, with short train rides between castles, harbours and the original LEGOLAND. Copenhagen is the main base, and it pairs well with a few days in Sweden or Norway on a wider Scandinavia tour.

destinations.name: Nyhavn
destinations.blurb: A 17th-century canal lined with painted townhouses and cafes, and the starting point for harbour boat tours.

destinations.name: Tivoli Gardens
destinations.blurb: One of the world's oldest amusement parks, in central Copenhagen, with gardens, rides and evening lights.

destinations.name: The Little Mermaid
destinations.blurb: A small bronze statue on the Copenhagen waterfront, based on the Hans Christian Andersen story.

destinations.name: Kronborg Castle
destinations.blurb: A Renaissance castle at Helsingor, known as the setting of Shakespeare's Hamlet.

destinations.name: Rosenborg Castle
destinations.blurb: A royal palace in central Copenhagen that houses the Danish crown jewels.

destinations.name: LEGOLAND Billund
destinations.blurb: The first LEGOLAND park, next to the LEGO company's home town, with rides and miniature cities.

destinations.name: Hans Christian Andersen House
destinations.blurb: A museum in Odense, the author's birthplace, telling his life story through his fairy tales.

devotional.name: Frederik's Church
devotional.blurb: Known as the Marble Church, with one of the largest church domes in Scandinavia, near Amalienborg Palace.

devotional.name: Church of Our Saviour
devotional.blurb: A baroque church in Christianshavn with an outdoor spiral staircase winding up its spire.

devotional.name: Copenhagen Cathedral
devotional.blurb: The city's main Lutheran church, with Bertel Thorvaldsen's marble statues of Christ and the apostles.

devotional.name: Roskilde Cathedral
devotional.blurb: A UNESCO-listed brick cathedral where Danish kings and queens have been buried for centuries.

dishes.name: Smorrebrod
dishes.blurb: Open sandwiches on dark rye bread, usually topped with herring, prawns or roast meats.

dishes.name: Frikadeller
dishes.blurb: Pan-fried meatballs of minced pork, served with potatoes and gravy.

dishes.name: Stegt Flaesk
dishes.blurb: Crisp fried pork belly with boiled potatoes and parsley sauce, often called the national dish.

dishes.name: Risalamande
dishes.blurb: Cold rice pudding folded with whipped cream and chopped almonds, served with warm cherry sauce.

dishes.name: Rodgrod med Flode
dishes.blurb: A thick red berry pudding served with cream, a classic summer dessert.

highlights: Canal boat tour from Nyhavn
Evening at Tivoli Gardens
Day trip to Kronborg Castle
Climbing the spiral spire of the Church of Our Saviour
Full day at LEGOLAND Billund
Cycling around Copenhagen's harbour
denmark.indianTraveller: Copenhagen has a good number of Indian restaurants and vegetarian options are clearly marked on most menus, flights from Hyderabad take about 12 to 14 hours with one stop, and Denmark uses European two-pin plugs; cards are accepted almost everywhere, so a forex card is more useful than cash.

sweden.intro: Sweden offers two quite different holidays: long summer days in Stockholm and its island archipelago, or snow, husky rides and the northern lights in Lapland in winter. Trains are comfortable, English is widely spoken, and Stockholm itself is spread across 14 islands linked by bridges and ferries.

destinations.name: Gamla Stan
destinations.blurb: Stockholm's old town of cobbled lanes, the Royal Palace and the colourful houses of Stortorget square.

destinations.name: Vasa Museum
destinations.blurb: Home of a 17th-century warship that sank on its first voyage and was raised almost intact in 1961.

destinations.name: Skansen
destinations.blurb: An open-air museum with historic Swedish houses and Nordic animals such as elk and brown bears.

destinations.name: Stockholm City Hall
destinations.blurb: A red-brick waterfront building whose Blue Hall hosts the Nobel Prize banquet each December.

destinations.name: Stockholm Archipelago
destinations.blurb: Thousands of islands reached by ferry, with fishing villages, swimming spots and summer cafes.

destinations.name: Liseberg
destinations.blurb: A large amusement park in Gothenburg with roller coasters and a well-known Christmas market.

destinations.name: Abisko National Park
destinations.blurb: A park in Swedish Lapland known for clear winter skies and some of the best northern lights viewing.

devotional.name: Uppsala Cathedral
devotional.blurb: The tallest church in Scandinavia, a Gothic cathedral where Carl Linnaeus is buried.

devotional.name: Storkyrkan
devotional.blurb: Stockholm's cathedral in Gamla Stan, with a famous wooden sculpture of St George and the Dragon.

devotional.name: Riddarholmen Church
devotional.blurb: A medieval church on a small island in Stockholm and the burial place of Swedish monarchs.

devotional.name: Lund Cathedral
devotional.blurb: A Romanesque cathedral in southern Sweden with a 15th-century astronomical clock.

devotional.name: Kiruna Church
devotional.blurb: A large wooden church in Lapland shaped like a Sami hut, being moved as the town relocates.

dishes.name: Kottbullar
dishes.blurb: Swedish meatballs with cream sauce, mashed potato and lingonberry jam.

dishes.name: Gravlax
dishes.blurb: Raw salmon cured with salt, sugar and dill, served with a sweet mustard sauce.

dishes.name: Kanelbulle
dishes.blurb: A soft cardamom-scented cinnamon bun, usually brushed with egg, eaten at the daily coffee break called fika.

dishes.name: Rarakor
dishes.blurb: Crisp pancakes of grated potato fried in butter and served with lingonberry jam.

dishes.name: Knackebrod with Cheese
dishes.blurb: Crunchy rye crispbread topped with butter and sharp Vasterbotten cheese.

highlights: Exploring the Vasa Museum
Ferry trip into the Stockholm Archipelago
Walking the lanes of Gamla Stan
Northern lights night in Abisko
Husky sledding in Swedish Lapland
Fika with cinnamon buns at a Stockholm cafe
sweden.indianTraveller: Stockholm and Gothenburg have plenty of Indian restaurants and vegetarian food is widely available, though choices thin out in Lapland, flights from Hyderabad take about 12 to 14 hours with one stop, and Sweden uses European two-pin plugs; many places are cashless, so carry a forex card.

iceland.intro: Iceland is a volcanic island of waterfalls, geysers, glaciers and black sand beaches, best explored on a road trip or guided tour from Reykjavik. Summer brings almost round-the-clock daylight, while winter visits are planned around the northern lights, so it is worth packing warm, waterproof layers in any season.

destinations.name: Thingvellir National Park
destinations.blurb: A rift valley where the North American and Eurasian plates pull apart, and the site of an ancient parliament.

destinations.name: Geysir and Strokkur
destinations.blurb: A geothermal field where the Strokkur geyser shoots hot water into the air every few minutes.

destinations.name: Gullfoss
destinations.blurb: A powerful two-step waterfall dropping into a narrow canyon on the Hvita river.

destinations.name: Seljalandsfoss and Skogafoss
destinations.blurb: Two tall waterfalls on the south coast, one with a path that runs behind the falling water.

destinations.name: Reynisfjara
destinations.blurb: A black sand beach near Vik with basalt columns and sea stacks, where the waves must be watched carefully.

destinations.name: Jokulsarlon
destinations.blurb: A glacier lagoon filled with floating icebergs, with boat tours and ice chunks washed up on nearby Diamond Beach.

destinations.name: Blue Lagoon
destinations.blurb: A geothermal spa near the airport with warm, milky-blue water set in a lava field.

devotional.name: Hallgrimskirkja
devotional.blurb: Reykjavik's tall concrete church, inspired by basalt columns, with a lift to a viewing deck in the tower.

devotional.name: Reykjavik Cathedral
devotional.blurb: A small 18th-century cathedral beside the parliament building in the city centre.

devotional.name: Landakotskirkja
devotional.blurb: The Catholic Cathedral of Christ the King in Reykjavik, with a flat-topped tower overlooking the old town.

devotional.name: Akureyrarkirkja
devotional.blurb: A hilltop church in the northern town of Akureyri, reached by a long flight of steps.

dishes.name: Plokkfiskur
dishes.blurb: Mashed boiled fish and potatoes in a creamy white sauce, served with rye bread.

dishes.name: Kjotsupa
dishes.blurb: A warming lamb soup with root vegetables and rice or oats.

dishes.name: Pylsur
dishes.blurb: Icelandic hot dogs made mainly with lamb, topped with fried onions and sweet mustard.

dishes.name: Skyr
dishes.blurb: A thick, protein-rich cultured dairy product, eaten plain, with berries or as a dessert.

dishes.name: Rugbraud
dishes.blurb: Dense, slightly sweet dark rye bread, traditionally baked slowly in geothermal ground.

highlights: Driving the Golden Circle
Walking behind the Seljalandsfoss waterfall
Boat tour among the icebergs at Jokulsarlon
Soaking at the Blue Lagoon
Northern lights hunt on a winter night
View over Reykjavik from Hallgrimskirkja tower
iceland.indianTraveller: Reykjavik has a few Indian restaurants and supermarkets stock vegetarian basics, but eating out is expensive and options are limited in the countryside; expect about 14 to 18 hours from Hyderabad with one or two stops in Europe, Iceland uses European two-pin plugs, and cards are accepted almost everywhere.
